limits: A2 is independently retyped from p79 and equals all336 source coordinates of the already reviewed p83 B. The existing p83 record is not counted again or changed.

The P-shaped source glyph at A1 index134 is outside the coordinate alphabet and remains a literal mask in the raw layer. Filling the E in FELDLAZ costs one mask fill and zero observed-coordinate substitutions.
The text reports that the formations were lost in Palestine except for parts of their personnel; it does not independently establish circumstances or casualty totals.
Both source headers retain their distinct4.02/4.09 p.m. interception times on30 October. Exact repeated ciphertext links the second parts without inventing a transmission history.
